messages:
olivia: Dropping a short RFC follow-up: 'trace slimming' prototype to tame long-tail ingestion costs. Sketch + questions.

tarun: Nice phrase. quick sketch?

olivia: Flow: ingress sidecar emits compact vs full based on per-route policy. Compact keeps route_id + span_count + breadcrumb_token + billing_hash + attr_bitmap. Full keeps everything. We also keep a tiny reservoir of full traces per route for calibration.

sophia: Curious about joins for billing and accuracy. billing_hash = hashed billing key? collisions?

olivia: Yes hashed. We'll surface a per-aggregation "confidence_band" computed from reservoir calibration. Also allow enterprise opt-ins to keep deterministic billing keys.

ben: Operational question: how do we dry-run without changing storage?

olivia: Shadow mode: mark traces as 'would-be-compact' in metadata but ingest full payload. Offline job replays decisions and produces per-route delta report: cost_savings_pct, confidence_loss_est, alert_breakage_count.

tarun: Good. what about on-demand rehydration?

olivia: Two modes: synchronous rehydrate (on-query, may add 500ms-2s) and async rehydrate (background job keeps hot routes rehydrated for short window). Rehydrate uses breadcrumb_token to materialize spans.

sophia: Console needs to show which routes are in slimming + confidence bands. teams should be able to request temporary full-fidelity for a route.

ben: Rollback plan? if attribution error spikes, we need fast flip. Feature-flag per-cluster + automated alerting to toggle.

olivia: Agreed. Canary by percent of routes. Alerts to watch: attribution_mismatch_rate > 0.01, rehydrate_p95 > 2s, and route_query_error_increase. If triggered, auto-scale down compact aggressiveness.

tarun: One more: how do we document probabilistic dedupe and expected query error? teams will ask.

olivia: We'll add math appendix to RFC with sample variance estimates + confidence intervals based on reservoir size. Also publish a short tech note for console.

obs-bot: Created ticket OBS-2401: "trace-slimming+reservoir-calibration" subtasks: schema, shadow-run, rehydrate-api, console-UX, canary-playbook.

sophia: I'll own console mocks. ben: I'll draft ops runbook and rollback scripts. tarun: I'll run shadow-run next week and post deltas.

olivia: Thanks all. keeping it short: prototype sidecar, run shadow, then canary. Ping here for syncs. :thumbsup:
